title: Lagos: Island to Lekki
description: Art, history and green space from Lagos Island to the Lekki peninsula. Drop a bugg at each to earn the badge.

spots.name: Freedom Park
spots.why: A colonial-era prison turned park, with concerts and art most weekends.

spots.name: Lekki-Ikoyi Link Bridge
spots.why: Lit up at night, and a favourite for a walk or a run over the lagoon.

spots.name: Nike Art Gallery
spots.why: Four floors of Nigerian art, from textiles to sculpture.

spots.name: Lekki Conservation Centre
spots.why: Home to one of Africa's longest canopy walkways.
